text:
nina: Quick cultural referendum: Is the chipped thermos in the pantry eligible for state funeral or merely a retirement party? :thermometer: (reactions: :thinking_face:)
harry: State funeral for sure. It survived three spills and a fall from the 3rd shelf. It has earned our respect. :trophy: (reactions: :pray:)
zola: We need rituals. Proposal: ceremonial last sip, eulogy, then place it on the Shelf of Legends.
mike: I can DJ the ceremony. Playlist suggestion: 'Pour Some Sugar on Me' (ironic) and 'Hot Cup of Courage'.
cleaning-bot: cleaning-bot: Scheduled cleaning notice: Please remove personal items by EOD if you want to keep them. Thermos retirement ceremony OK in pantry after cleaning. (automated)
snack-bot: Vote recorded: 18 votes for state funeral, 3 for retirement party. Free biscotti at the ceremony. RSVP here: https://intranet/events/thermos-farewell
nina: Ceremony set for Friday 4:15pm. Costumes optional. Also, we must decide on an epitaph. Ideas?
zola: 'Here lies Thermos #7: Kept coffee warm; morale warmer.' :sparkles:
harry: I'll write the poem. Also capturing for lore. This will be added to the Office Chronicles under 'Rituals & Mugs'. :book:
